The search turned up several comparison guides, mostly from vendors, affiliates, or aggregators, so the details below are only a rough guide.

- **Shortcut** is the most common pick for a Linear-like experience. One review says if you want Linear's speed plus a roadmap and docs without the seat creep, Shortcut is the closest swap. A ranking site lists its pricing at free - $8.50/user/mo.
- **Plane** is the open-source option. One review suggests that if finance demands you own your data, self-host Plane for free. A German guide describes it as Linear-ähnliche UX, open-source, but notes it is a jüngeres Produkt, weniger Integrationen (a younger product with fewer integrations).
- **Height** is positioned for smaller teams. One guide lists its ideal team size as 5-100. Pricing is reported as free - $9.90/user/mo on one site. One directory marks Height as Discontinued, which conflicts with the other sources, so verify its status before relying on it.
- **Jira** is the enterprise option. One guide calls it Enterprise-agile-PM mit dem tiefsten Ökosystem auf dem Markt (enterprise agile PM with the deepest ecosystem on the market). Its pricing is listed as free - $7.90/user/mo.
- **Other options** include GitHub Projects, which one review recommends for teams that live in GitHub, plus ClickUp and Asana for broader non-engineering use.

Pricing and free-tier details differ across sources, and Linear's own limits are described as cloud-only, per-seat, and the free plan caps you at 250 issues and 2 teams. Check current vendor pricing directly before deciding.

content.text:
Linear's main competitors, from a single web search, are below. Most of the sources are vendor, affiliate or aggregator pages, so treat the details as a rough guide.

| Tool | Positioning vs. Linear | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Jira** | The enterprise standard, with the deepest ecosystem. | Heavier and more configurable. Listed at about free to $7.90/user/mo. |
| **Shortcut** | The closest Linear-style experience, with roadmaps and docs. | Listed at about free to $8.50/user/mo. |
| **Plane** | Open-source and self-hostable, so you own your data. | A younger product with fewer integrations. |
| **Height** | Aimed at small teams of roughly 5–100 people. | Listed at about free to $9.90/user/mo. One directory marks it as discontinued, so check its status first. |
| **GitHub Projects** | Suits teams that already work in GitHub. | Less feature-rich as a standalone tracker. |
| **ClickUp / Asana** | Broader project management that also covers non-engineering teams. | Less focused on engineering workflows. |

The sources describe Linear as cloud-only and per-seat. Its free plan is capped at 250 issues and 2 teams.

I didn't check any vendor's own pricing page. Pricing and free-tier details differ between the sources, so confirm them with each vendor before deciding.
